See engines/ for exact configure flags, license files and engines/sources/ for exact unmodified source archives and reconstruction script. Build dependencies (Ubuntu MinGW/CMake/pkg-config) are not included in the end-user app. Users can replace the LGPL command-line engines in engines/ with compatible builds. No keys, credentials or external service are required for processing.

The installer is created with Inno Setup 6, retaining compiler copyright and license notices in the generated setup. Build/installer compiler is not embedded as a tool for conversions.
